actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description:
The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It
can replace one attack with a use of Paralyzing Breath.

actions.name: Rend
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8
+ 6) Slashing damage. Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6). Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure:

actions.name: each creature in a 30-foot Cone
actions.description: First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
